title_zh: Natural elements — 第14节可背诵讲义
body_en: Weather shows nature at work. Wind moves clouds. Sun heats the land. Rain fills rivers. Keep a seven-day weather diary with simple words: sunny, rainy, windy, cold. Compare your notes with a classmate. Science begins when you notice patterns.
body_zh: 天气展现自然如何运作。风推动云，阳光加热大地，雨水注满河流。用简单词做七天天气日记：晴、雨、风、冷。和同学对比笔记。当你发现规律，科学就开始了。
